Definition: Tsophim, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Zophim is the field on the top of Pisgah where Balak took Balaam to curse Israel. In Numbers 23:14, he brought him into the field of Zophim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zophim matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
